nom: Neutrogena On-The-Spot Acne Spot Treatment Cream with 2.5% Benzoyl Peroxide

segments.sensitive: Reports conflict: a couple of reviewers describe the formula as gentle even on sensitive skin with good results, while another reviewer with self-described over-sensitive skin reacted to the benzoyl peroxide with more breakouts and had to stop using it.
segments.mature: One reviewer notes acne isn't only a teenage problem and reports the product clears breakouts quickly for older skin too.

concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers report it works without excessive dryness when used as directed, in small amounts, on the spot only; others report the opposite, including one whose forehead stayed red and dry for at least five days after a single small application, and another who says it simply leaves skin very dry.
concerns.redness: Multiple reviewers report visibly reduced redness and swelling around blemishes, in some cases within hours; one reviewer instead reports the treated area became red and dry and stayed that way for at least five days.
concerns.blemishes: The large majority of reviewers, including some with hormonal or PCOS-related acne, report pimples visibly shrinking or clearing within one to a few days of spot application; one reviewer with sensitive skin instead reports the benzoyl peroxide caused more breakouts in the areas where she applied it.

aspects.libelle: Small tube but product goes a long way
Lightweight, absorbs fast, no white residue
Can sting or itch on application
Fast, visible results within a few days

extraits.texte: I put a teeny tiny bit on a spot that was forming on my forehead. One application. One small amount. That area of my forehead has been red and dry since then. It's been about 5 days and the skin has not gotten better. To this product's credit, the acne spot went away, but the red and dryness is way worse. Will my skin ever return to normal?

I did not like the effect of this product at all. I bought this product thinking it will help me with my breakouts (I am 30 years old and still have these teenagers breakouts. I tried many products over the years, took pills that helped a lot but made my skin very sensitive). I use Neutrogena's Oil-Free Acne Wash Facial Cleanser, and I was hoping this will be good for me. It is the first time I am trying a product like this one. I am always afraid to try anything new because of my over sensitive skin. The product arrived on time and in good shape. The tube is small, but considering the amount you need to apply on your face, there is much cream material inside. It is very easy to use and has no smell. I read the reviews that some people had great results and thought maybe I would be lucky. I did not. I believe that what happened is that my skin does not react well to the active ingredient (Benzoyl Peroxide), and the result was I had more breakouts on places where I applied it. I used this product for two weeks, and nothing good happened. Once I have stopped using this product, my face started to calm down. It has been three weeks since I have stopped and My face is still healing from the breakouts. I guess that if you are not that sensitive to the Benzoyl, you get better results, but this was not my case.
Great acne cream. It works to get rid of acne, but leaves skin very dry.

I’ve been using this acne cream for a few weeks and I’m very happy with the results. It helped reduce redness and breakouts without drying out my skin too much. The texture is lightweight, absorbs quickly, and doesn’t leave a greasy feeling. My skin looks clearer and smoother, and new pimples seem to heal faster. I would definitely recommend it to anyone struggling with mild to moderate acne.
